title: A 3% Move Signaling Less Volatility?
summary: Last night was a truly wild one – and I’m not just talking about the “blue-nami” with a “red undertow.” What I’m referring to is the complete 180 that occurred in the market’s mentality while I was asleep. From last night’s lows through this morning’s highs, ES December futures based upon the S&P 500 (SPX) had an intraday range of more than 3%. Some of that can be attributed to putting electoral uncertainty behind us, but it’s quite difficult to reconcile a huge bout of “socially acceptable volatility” with the “lower volatility” explanation offered by many.
